name: cmdb_relentity
label: Configuration Item Instance Association Table
description: The table for configuring item instances for CMDB is used for related queries in configuration management and reporting scenarios.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: rel_id
fields.description: The attribute ID is associated. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: from_cientity_id
fields.description: Source configuration item ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: to_cientity_id
fields.description: Target configuration item ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: from_index
fields.description: The data identifier is used to improve efficiency during retrieval, generating only the first N records.

fields.name: to_index
fields.description: The data identifier is used to improve efficiency during retrieval, generating only the first N records.

fields.name: renew_time
fields.description: Update time, used to determine aging.

fields.name: valid_day
fields.description: Number of effective days, with an empty value representing a long-term effective status.

fields.name: expired_time
fields.description: Expiration date. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: source_relentity_id
fields.description: Source relationship ID, non-null indicates a cascading relationship. The source relationship deletion also deletes this relationship. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_expiredtime
indexes.description: Standard index covering the expired_time field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_from_cientity_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the from_cientity_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_from_index
indexes.description: Standard index covering the rel_id, from_cientity_id, from_index fields, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_from_to
indexes.description: Unique index covering the rel_id, from_cientity_id, to_cientity_id fields, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.

indexes.name: idx_source_relentity_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the source_relentity_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_to_cientity_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the to_cientity_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_to_index
indexes.description: Standard index covering the rel_id, to_cientity_id, to_index fields, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
